name: gamedata-army
what: A mixed army in the field: a line of spearmen in front, archers behind, a few mounted spearmen on a flank

game.note: Skirmish a few minutes in, about 20 soldiers of three kinds standing in formation on open grass; clouds off; daylight

name: gamedata-town
what: A grown town from above: Manor, Village, farms, Barracks, Stables, Guildhall and a stockade with a gatehouse

game.note: A skirmish 15 to 20 minutes in (or a save of one), camera high enough to show the town centre and its buildings; clouds off

name: gamedata-research
what: A Blacksmith selected: its research buttons shown, one research under way with its progress bar

game.note: A town with a finished Blacksmith and enough resources; start one research so the progress bar shows

name: gamedata-commands
what: An archer selected: the command buttons round the selection panel (Hold Fire, Fire at Will, Hold Ground, Skirmish Mode, Formation, Garrison)

game.note: Two or three archers selected, mouse over one command button so its tooltip shows

name: gamedata-peasants-at-work
what: Peasants at work: some chopping trees, some farming a field, one carrying wood back to the Manor

game.note: The start of a skirmish after a minute or two, peasants spread over a wood and a farm; daylight

name: gamedata-knight-charge
what: Knights in a wedge formation charging into a group of enemy archers

game.note: A skirmish with Chivalry researched and 8 to 10 knights; a wedge formation moving into enemy missile troops

name: gamedata-trebuchet
what: A trebuchet set up and throwing at an enemy tower or wall, the stone in the air

game.note: A sapper-built trebuchet within range of an enemy stone tower; capture the moment of the throw
